set_env_vars: set environment variables for distributed training including world size, ranks, and nccl settings from a config object
get_machine_local_and_dist_rank: get the local and distributed rank of the current gpu from environment variables
print_system_env_info: print sorted system environment variables for debugging where the application is running
setup_path_manager: register options for the distributed file system path manager to support different backends
configure_nccl_env: configure nccl debug and socket nthreads environment variables for distributed gpu training
